verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ מַקְשֶׁה־ עֹ֑רֶף תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš maq·šeh- ‘ō·rep̄ tō·w·ḵā·ḥō·wṯ pe·ṯa‘ yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·’ên mar·pê
verses.literal: A man who remains stiff-necked . . . after much reproof will suddenly be shattered - beyond recovery

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיקִים בִּרְב֣וֹת הָעָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֣ח רָ֝שָׁ֗ע וּבִמְשֹׁ֥ל עָֽם׃ יֵאָ֥נַֽח
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dî·qîm bir·ḇō·wṯ hā·‘ām yiś·maḥ rā·šā‘ ū·ḇim·šōl ‘ām yê·’ā·naḥ
verses.literal: When the righteous flourish the people rejoice but when the wicked rule the people groan

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־ אֹהֵ֣ב חָ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑יו וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד־ הֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- ’ō·hêḇ ḥāḵ·māh yə·śam·maḥ ’ā·ḇîw wə·rō·‘eh zō·w·nō·wṯ yə·’ab·beḏ- hō·wn
verses.literal: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth

verses.original: בְּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מֶ֗לֶךְ יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·miš·pāṭ me·leḵ ya·‘ă·mîḏ ’ā·reṣ wə·’îš tə·rū·mō·wṯ ye·her·sen·nāh
verses.literal: By justice a king brings stability to the land but a man who exacts tribute demolishes it

verses.original: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק רֵעֵ֑הוּ פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל־ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת עַל־ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ge·ḇer ma·ḥă·lîq rê·‘ê·hū pō·w·rêś ‘al- re·šeṯ ‘al- pə·‘ā·māw
verses.literal: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads . . . a net for his feet

verses.original: רָ֣ע אִ֣ישׁ מוֹקֵ֑שׁ בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: rā‘ ’îš mō·w·qêš bə·p̄e·ša‘ wə·ṣad·dîq yā·rūn wə·śā·mê·aḥ
verses.literal: An evil man is caught by his own sin but a righteous one sings and rejoices

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק יֹדֵ֣עַ דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq yō·ḏê·a‘ dîn dal·lîm rā·šā‘ lō- yā·ḇîn dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: The righteous consider the cause of the poor but the wicked have no regard for such concerns

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê lā·ṣō·wn yā·p̄î·ḥū qir·yāh wa·ḥă·ḵā·mîm yā·šî·ḇū ’āp̄
verses.literal: Mockers . . . inflame a city but the wise turn away anger

verses.original: חָכָ֗ם אִֽישׁ־ נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת־ אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām ’îš- niš·pāṭ ’eṯ- ’îš ’ĕ·wîl wə·rā·ḡaz wə·śā·ḥaq wə·’ên nā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: If a wise man goes to court with . . . a fool there will be raving and laughing with no resolution

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־ תָ֑ם וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ḏā·mîm yiś·nə·’ū- ṯām wî·šā·rîm yə·ḇaq·šū nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man but the upright care for his life

verses.original: כְסִ֑יל יוֹצִ֣יא כָּל־ ר֭וּחוֹ וְ֝חָכָ֗ם יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃ בְּאָח֥וֹר
verses.transliteration: ḵə·sîl yō·w·ṣî kāl- rū·ḥōw wə·ḥā·ḵām yə·šab·bə·ḥen·nāh bə·’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: A fool vents all his anger but a wise man holds it back

verses.original: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־ דְּבַר־ שָׁ֑קֶר כָּֽל־ מְשָׁרְתָ֥יו רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šêl maq·šîḇ ‘al- də·ḇar- šā·qer kāl- mə·šā·rə·ṯāw rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: If a ruler listens to lies . . . all his officials will be wicked

verses.original: רָ֤שׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ יְהוָֽה׃ מֵ֤אִיר־ עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: rāš wə·’îš tə·ḵā·ḵîm nip̄·gā·šū Yah·weh mê·’îr- ‘ê·nê šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: The poor man and the oppressor . . . have this in common The LORD gives light to the eyes of both

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט דַּלִּ֑ים בֶּֽאֱמֶ֣ת כִּ֝סְא֗וֹ יִכּֽוֹן׃ לָעַ֥ד
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ šō·w·p̄êṭ dal·lîm be·’ĕ·meṯ kis·’ōw yik·kō·wn lā·‘aḏ
verses.literal: A king who judges the poor with fairness his throne will be established forever

verses.original: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה וְנַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šê·ḇeṭ wə·ṯō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ yit·tên ḥāḵ·māh wə·na·‘ar mə·šul·lāḥ mê·ḇîš ’im·mōw
verses.literal: A rod of correction imparts wisdom but a child left to himself disgraces his mother

verses.original: רְ֭שָׁעִים בִּרְב֣וֹת פָּ֑שַׁע יִרְבֶּה־ וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים יִרְאֽוּ׃ בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: rə·šā·‘îm bir·ḇō·wṯ pā·ša‘ yir·beh- wə·ṣad·dî·qîm yir·’ū bə·map·pal·tām
verses.literal: When the wicked thrive rebellion increases but the righteous will see their downfall

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִֽינִיחֶ֑ךָ וְיִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yas·sêr bin·ḵā wî·nî·ḥe·ḵā wə·yit·tên ma·‘ă·ḏan·nîm lə·nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Discipline your son and he will give you rest he will bring delight to your soul

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן עָ֑ם יִפָּ֣רַֽע אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃ וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: bə·’ên ḥā·zō·wn ‘ām yip·pā·ra‘ ’aš·rê·hū wə·šō·mêr tō·w·rāh
verses.literal: Where [there is] no vision the people cast off restraint but blessed [is] he who keeps the Law

verses.original: עָ֑בֶד לֹא־ יִוָּ֣סֶר בִּ֭דְבָרִים כִּֽי־ יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇeḏ lō- yiw·wā·ser biḏ·ḇā·rîm kî- yā·ḇîn wə·’ên ma·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: A servant cannot be corrected by words [alone] though he understands he will not respond

verses.original: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו אָ֣ץ תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zî·ṯā ’îš biḏ·ḇā·rāw ’āṣ tiq·wāh liḵ·sîl mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Do you see a man who speaks in haste There is more hope for a fool than for him

verses.original: עַבְדּ֑וֹ מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן׃ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘aḇ·dōw mə·p̄an·nêq min·nō·‘ar yih·yeh mā·nō·wn wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: A servant pampered from his youth will bring grief in the end

verses.original: אַ֭ף אִֽישׁ־ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן חֵמָ֣ה וּבַ֖עַל רַב־ פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ ’îš- yə·ḡā·reh mā·ḏō·wn ḥê·māh ū·ḇa·‘al raḇ- pā·ša‘
verses.literal: An angry man stirs up dissension and a hot-tempered man abounds in transgression

verses.original: אָ֭דָם גַּאֲוַ֣ת תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑נּוּ וּשְׁפַל־ ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ga·’ă·waṯ taš·pî·len·nū ū·šə·p̄al- rū·aḥ yiṯ·mōḵ kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: A man’s pride will bring him low but a humble spirit will obtain honor

verses.original: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם־ גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע אָלָ֥ה וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·lêq ‘im- gan·nāḇ śō·w·nê nap̄·šōw yiš·ma‘ ’ā·lāh wə·lō yag·gîḏ
verses.literal: A partner to a thief hates his own soul he receives the oath but does not testify

verses.original: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥer·daṯ ’ā·ḏām yit·tên mō·w·qêš ū·ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh yə·śug·gāḇ
verses.literal: The fear of man is a snare but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים מוֹשֵׁ֑ל פְּנֵי־ אִֽישׁ׃ מִשְׁפַּט־ וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm mə·ḇaq·šîm mō·wō·šêl pə·nê- ’îš miš·paṭ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Many seek the ruler’s favor but a man receives justice from the LORD

verses.original: עָ֑וֶל אִ֣ישׁ תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים דָּֽרֶךְ׃פ יְשַׁר־ וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·wel ’îš tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ ṣad·dî·qîm dā·reḵ yə·šar- wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ rā·šā‘
verses.literal: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked
